title: Produce substantial fat loss while preserving skeletal muscle and strength

concept.text: Improve the composition and functional consequences of drug-induced weight loss by preserving muscle. BELIEVE demonstrated substantially less DXA lean-mass loss with bimagrumab plus semaglutide; preservation of clinically important muscle function still needs decisive validation. Proposed completion test: Regulatory approval of a muscle-preservation claim after a randomized trial of at least 500 adults over at least 52 weeks, showing ≥15% mean weight loss, ≥90% of lost weight attributable to fat, and prespecified preservation of MRI-measured muscle and strength against clinically justified noninferiority margins. Test set by: Proposed editorial test; regulators would determine the acceptable indication and functional endpoints. BELIEVE's composition endpoints are trial milestones, not an accepted regulatory definition of muscle preservation. Overlaps: END-05, ORT-06. Sources given: [BELIEVE randomized phase 2 publication](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04204-0.pdf) ; [Scholar Rock November 2026 programme and regulatory update](https://scholarrock.gcs-web.com/static-files/d095bef0-0511-454b-ad49-13d8ef6afbee).
